title: D1-1c | VFD Minimum Stable Pressure and Operating Window
question_prompt:
D1-1c | VFD Minimum Stable Pressure and Operating Window

A mobile SWRO unit uses a variable-frequency-drive high-pressure pump. Each intake condition must meet minimum production without violating recovery, flux, rejection, or permeate-salinity limits. Determine each condition's Pmin, then compare it with the VFD minimum stable pressure of 47.0 bar and the pump upper limit of 63.0 bar to select the actual operating setpoint and operating window.

Fixed parameter | Value | Unit | Status | Intake condition | NaCl mass fraction | Temperature (deg C)
Feed mass flow | 3 | kg/s | Fixed / locked | A Low-Salinity Warm Water | 0.03 | 32
Membrane area | 300 | m^2 | Fixed / locked | B Normal Seawater | 0.035 | 25
A_comp | 4.3e-12 | m/s/Pa | Fixed / locked | C High-Salinity Cold Water | 0.039 | 12
B_comp | 3.4e-08 | m/s | Fixed / locked
Permeate pressure | 1 | bar | Fixed / locked | Acceptance constraints
Pressure drop | 0.9 | bar | Fixed / locked | Permeate production, Qp | A >= 4.15; B >= 4.20; C >= 4.40 m^3/h | Each condition
Channel height | 0.002 | m | Fixed / locked | Water recovery | <= 55.0% | Each condition
Spacer porosity | 0.75 | - | Fixed / locked | Average water flux | <= 20.0 LMH | Each condition
Module length | 20 | m | Fixed / locked | Salt rejection | >= 98.70% | Each condition
Permeate NaCl | <= 500 mg/L | Each condition

Required work
1. Treat this as a multi-condition pressure-sizing and feasibility problem. Do not change locked membrane or hydraulic parameters while searching pressure.
2. For each condition, begin from a reasonable pressure and use Qp, recovery, flux, rejection, and permeate NaCl to identify the active failing constraint.
3. Establish an independent fail/pass bracket for every condition and refine adaptively to 0.05 bar. Do not use a mechanical dense grid scan.
4. Compare all Pmin values or infeasibility evidence with the stated equipment margin, limits, or control window, then make the engineering decision.
5. Distinguish equipment rating/limits from operating setpoints. Do not hide a membrane-flux or water-quality violation by blindly increasing pressure.

Required pressure resolution: 0.05 bar. Any design margin, pump limit, VFD lower limit, maintenance reserve, or equipment selection increment in this benchmark is a stated rule used to produce a unique, auditable answer.
reference_answer:
D1-1c | VFD Minimum Stable Pressure and Operating Window | Stepwise Answer

Reference efficient trajectory: about 9-11 calls to simulate_ro. Coarsely bracket each condition, refine only the live interval to 0.05 bar, preserve adjacent fail/pass evidence, and then complete the equipment-versus-operation decision.

Engineering meaning | Do not operate below 47.0 bar | Operate near its own boundary | Highest required process setpoint | Setpoint changes with intake condition | Do not run all conditions at 63 bar | Upper-window check | =63-MAX(H22:H24) | bar reserve | 6.1

The calculated Pmin values are 46.65, 52.35, and 56.90 bar. Condition A is clamped upward to the 47.0 bar VFD minimum stable pressure, while B and C operate at 52.35 and 56.90 bar. All three setpoints lie within the 47-63 bar equipment window; the correct operating strategy is condition-dependent, not a single 63 bar setpoint.

Simulator evidence note: Each intake condition has an adjacent 0.05 bar fail/pass pair, including both VFD-window edge cases.
